# Finn-tannlege — Claude directory pack

Submission pack for listing the remote MCP server `https://finn-tannlege.com/mcp` in the Claude connectors directory.

## Where and who

- **Portal:** https://claude.ai/directory/manage → **Submit new** → **MCP connector**.
- **Who:** Daniel, from his own Claude Pro or Max account. Any paid plan can submit, and on Pro or Max you submit from your own account with no organization or role to set up (https://claude.com/docs/directory/publish, read 2026-10-17).
- **Order:** Rett fra Bonden, then Opplevagent, then Finn-tannlege.

## How this pack is made

This README and every file in `claude-directory/` are generated by `scripts/gen-connector-packs.ts` from:

- the tools the live /mcp server registers (`registeredMcpToolDefinitions()` in src/services/mcp-tool-manifest.ts, with PAYMENTS_ENABLED unset as in production): names, titles, annotations and descriptions;
- the brand entry in src/config/brand-entities.ts (`BRAND_ENTITIES.dental`): name, URLs, support e-mail and example prompts;
- the catalog floor in distribution/catalog-claims.json: the honest catalog count (`honestCatalogCount()`) rounded down to the hundred;
- the protocol versions the MCP SDK supports (`SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS` in @modelcontextprotocol/sdk), for the Connection step: an SDK upgrade can change them;
- the icon and screenshot files themselves (size and md5);
- the `new McpServer(...)` call in src/routes/dental-mcp.ts, read with the TypeScript parser and not run: its serverInfo fields and whether it sends instructions;
- the hand-kept prose and recorded rows in `PACKS`.

src/routes/connector-packs-fresh.test.ts fails when a file here differs from what the generator writes. After a change to any of these, run `npx tsx scripts/gen-connector-packs.ts` and commit the result. `--verify-floors` compares the floors with the live honest counts.

## Not a directory path

- Desktop extension (MCPB): the directory no longer accepts local servers packaged as MCPB. The npm package `finn-tannlege-mcp` still works for manual install, but it is not a directory submission.

Source: A2A dev-request 2026-10-16-merkevare-entitet-og-connector-pakker, G3-S6.
